midyear_population: Holds country midyear population counts — grain: one row per country_code × year; keys/measures: country_code, country_name, year, midyear_population.
birth_death_growth_rates: Holds country vital-rate and growth indicators — grain: one row per country_code × year; keys/measures: country_code, country_name, year, crude_birth_rate, crude_death_rate, net_migration, rate_natural_increase, growth_rate.
country_names_area: Holds country name and area metadata — grain: one row per country_code (country); keys/measures: country_code, country_name, country_area.
midyear_population_agespecific: Holds country age- and sex-specific midyear populations — grain: one row per country_code × year × sex × age; keys/measures: country_code, country_name, year, sex, age, population.
midyear_population_5yr_age_sex: Holds country 5-year age-group midyear populations by sex — grain: one row per country_code × year × age group (starting_age/ending_age) × total_flag; keys/measures: country_code, country_name, year, total_flag, starting_age, age_group_indicator, ending_age, midyear_population, midyear_population_male, midyear_population_female.
midyear_population_age_sex: Holds country single-year age distributions by sex in wide form — grain: one row per country_code × year × sex (with max_age); keys/measures: country_code, country_name, year, sex, max_age and population_age_0 through population_age_34.
age_specific_fertility_rates: Holds country age-specific fertility and summary fertility indicators — grain: one row per country_code × year; keys/measures: country_code, country_name, year, fertility_rate_15_19, fertility_rate_20_24, fertility_rate_25_29, fertility_rate_30_34, fertility_rate_35_39, fertility_rate_40_44, fertility_rate_45_49, total_fertility_rate, gross_reproduction_rate, sex_ratio_at_birth.
mortality_life_expectancy: Holds country infant/child mortality and life expectancy indicators — grain: one row per country_code × year; keys/measures: country_code, country_name, year, infant_mortality, infant_mortality_male, infant_mortality_female, life_expectancy, life_expectancy_male, life_expectancy_female, mortality_rate_under5, mortality_rate_under5_male, mortality_rate_under5_female, mortality_rate_1to4, mortality_rate_1to4_male, mortality_rate_1to4_female.
